situation.zh: 今天是你到新组的第一天。组会开始前,组长请你做个简短的自我介绍:你叫什么、之前做什么、来做哪部分工作。
situation.en: It is your first day with a new team. Before the meeting starts, the team lead asks you to introduce yourself briefly: your name, what you did before, and what you will be working on here.

npc.persona: A team lead running a small stand-up. Welcoming, keeps things light, never puts anyone on the spot.
npc.greeting: Before we start, would you like to say a few words about yourself?

hit: Thanks, Lin. Three years on warehouse systems, and you will be taking the stock reports here. Good to have you. Priya sits next to you and knows those reports well.
That is helpful, thank you. So reporting is your area. We will get you into the Thursday review then.
partial: Thank you. And which part will you be working on with us?
Got your name. Tell us a little about what you did before?
miss: Sorry, could you say that again?
Hmm, I did not catch that. One more time?

slots.zh_hint: 说明你在这里负责什么
表达开放态度(专业度与亲和标记)

reference_answer: My name is Lin. I worked on warehouse systems for three years, and here I will be taking care of the stock reports.

provenance.rationale: 入职、转组、加入项目时的简短自我介绍几乎人人都要做,而且往往决定了同事第一次怎么记住你、后面找谁问什么。它是职场归属的入口,一次说不清就要靠后面很多次弥补。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(群体归属)。name / worked / years / job 属高频职场词;professional 级的难度在于一次交流里组织三个信息单元并保持简短,而不要求时态或冠词完全正确。
